_note: Example questions for the two-agent demo. Only the question is prepared; Agent 1 writes the answer live, so results can differ between runs. 'why' says what each question tests.

questions.label: Daily allowance and approval
questions.question: How much can I claim per day for an overseas business trip, and does my claim need approval?
questions.why: v1 and v2 disagree ($120 + auto-approval vs $150 + manager approval). An assistant with a stale index may mix them.

questions.label: Hotel limit and claim deadline
questions.question: What is the hotel limit and the deadline for submitting an overseas travel claim?
questions.why: v1 says $200/night and 60 days; current v2 says $250/night and 30 days.

questions.label: Receipts
questions.question: Do I need receipts for my travel expenses?
questions.why: Covered by v2 5.2 and SOP 3.2. Usually answered correctly.

questions.label: Finance processing time
questions.question: How long does Finance take to process an approved expense claim, and when will I be paid?

questions.label: Business class flights
questions.question: Can I fly business class on a 10-hour flight to London?
questions.why: Conditional rule (v2 4.4): allowed for 8h+ flights with prior Department Head approval.

questions.label: Laundry on a short trip
questions.question: Can I claim laundry costs on a 3-day business trip?
questions.why: Not reimbursable for trips shorter than 5 days (v2 section 6).

questions.label: Maternity leave (not covered)
questions.question: How much paid maternity leave do employees get?
questions.why: No document covers this. Expect the assistant to decline, or TrustGuard to return Insufficient evidence.
